+# CategoryTheory.homTensorDegreewiseMap_iteratedDifferential_summand
+
+## Reason
+
+The new proof needs local irreducibility attributes to avoid repeated unfolding
+of chosen Hom-complex data and projection maps during elaboration. The delivery
+checker treats added command text conservatively as an interface change and
+requires this record. These attributes are explicitly local to this module.
+The public theorem signature and visibility stay identical; no definition body,
+target meaning, or exported reducibility attribute changes.
+
+## Old
+
+The theorem signature was:
+
+```lean
+theorem homTensorDegreewiseMap_iteratedDifferential_summand
+    (K L M : CochainComplex Mod ℤ) (n t p q : ℤ) (h : p + q = t) :
+    letI := SheafOfModules.monoidalCategory R
+    let T := CochainComplex.mapBifunctor K L (curriedTensor Mod)
+    let ι := CochainComplex.ιMapBifunctor K L (curriedTensor Mod) p q t h
+    (homComplex (R := R) K (homComplex (R := R) L M)).d n (n + 1) ≫
+        homTensorDegreewiseMap R K L M (n + 1) ≫
+          homTensorProjection R T M (n + 1) t (t + (n + 1)) rfl ≫
+            SheafOfModules.homObjMap (R := R) ι (𝟙 (M.X (t + (n + 1)))) =
+      (homTensorDegreewiseMap R K L M n ≫
+        homTensorProjection R T M n t (t + n) rfl ≫
+          SheafOfModules.homObjMap (R := R) ι (M.d (t + n) (t + (n + 1)))) -
+      n.negOnePow • (homTensorDegreewiseMap R K L M n ≫
+        homTensorProjection R T M n (t + 1) (t + (n + 1)) (by omega) ≫
+          SheafOfModules.homObjMap (R := R)
+            (HomologicalComplex.mapBifunctor.d₁ K L (curriedTensor Mod)
+              (ComplexShape.up ℤ) p q (t + 1)) (𝟙 (M.X (t + (n + 1))))) -
+      n.negOnePow • (homTensorDegreewiseMap R K L M n ≫
+        homTensorProjection R T M n (t + 1) (t + (n + 1)) (by omega) ≫
+          SheafOfModules.homObjMap (R := R)
+            (HomologicalComplex.mapBifunctor.d₂ K L (curriedTensor Mod)
+              (ComplexShape.up ℤ) p q (t + 1)) (𝟙 (M.X (t + (n + 1)))))
+```
+
+There were no local irreducibility commands in the original module.
+
+## New
+
+The theorem signature is unchanged, verbatim:
+
+```lean
+theorem homTensorDegreewiseMap_iteratedDifferential_summand
+    (K L M : CochainComplex Mod ℤ) (n t p q : ℤ) (h : p + q = t) :
+    letI := SheafOfModules.monoidalCategory R
+    let T := CochainComplex.mapBifunctor K L (curriedTensor Mod)
+    let ι := CochainComplex.ιMapBifunctor K L (curriedTensor Mod) p q t h
+    (homComplex (R := R) K (homComplex (R := R) L M)).d n (n + 1) ≫
+        homTensorDegreewiseMap R K L M (n + 1) ≫
+          homTensorProjection R T M (n + 1) t (t + (n + 1)) rfl ≫
+            SheafOfModules.homObjMap (R := R) ι (𝟙 (M.X (t + (n + 1)))) =
+      (homTensorDegreewiseMap R K L M n ≫
+        homTensorProjection R T M n t (t + n) rfl ≫
+          SheafOfModules.homObjMap (R := R) ι (M.d (t + n) (t + (n + 1)))) -
+      n.negOnePow • (homTensorDegreewiseMap R K L M n ≫
+        homTensorProjection R T M n (t + 1) (t + (n + 1)) (by omega) ≫
+          SheafOfModules.homObjMap (R := R)
+            (HomologicalComplex.mapBifunctor.d₁ K L (curriedTensor Mod)
+              (ComplexShape.up ℤ) p q (t + 1)) (𝟙 (M.X (t + (n + 1))))) -
+      n.negOnePow • (homTensorDegreewiseMap R K L M n ≫
+        homTensorProjection R T M n (t + 1) (t + (n + 1)) (by omega) ≫
+          SheafOfModules.homObjMap (R := R)
+            (HomologicalComplex.mapBifunctor.d₂ K L (curriedTensor Mod)
+              (ComplexShape.up ℤ) p q (t + 1)) (𝟙 (M.X (t + (n + 1)))))
+```
+
+The proof now uses these two module-local commands, placed before the helpers
+and before the main theorem respectively:
+
+```lean
+attribute [local irreducible] homComplex homComplexFunctor
+attribute [local irreducible] homTensorDegreewiseMap homTensorProjection
+```
+
+Only private helpers and proof-only imports are added to the existing module.
+The two new public lemmas, `homTensorSummandPure_ext` and
+`homTensor_pure_differentials`, are separately documented by their new DAG nodes.
+The latter reuses `homTensorSectionMap_natural` from the existing
+`Sheaf.Algebra.Homology.HomTensorSectionNaturality`; its proof remains sorry.
+No new naturality declaration or node is delivered.
+
+## Users
+
+`tools/downstream.py --uses homTensorDegreewiseMap_iteratedDifferential_summand`
+finds the following direct textual users. The wider transitive closure has no
+changed statement or definition to adapt; local attributes do not propagate.
+
+| module | group holding it | effect |
+| --- | --- | --- |
+| Sheaf.Algebra.Homology.HomTensorDifferentialSummand | Q2 | Its proof changes; signature identical. |
+| Sheaf.Algebra.Homology.HomTensorDifferentialComponent | unclaimed | None; the imported theorem has its exact original type. No adaptation. |
+
+No module held by another group is edited. No target statement or definition
+changes and no target meaning review is reopened.
+
+## Status

+/-!
+# Pure-tensor extensionality for one internal Hom
+
+Source: Stacks Project, Modules on Sites, Section 03EK and Lemma 03EO.
+-/
+
+@[expose] public section

+universe u v

+open CategoryTheory CategoryTheory.MonoidalCategory Opposite

+variable {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] {J : GrothendieckTopology C}

+  ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat.{max u v} RingCat.{max u v})).obj R)

+private def constantGradedComplex (A : Mod) : CochainComplex Mod ℤ where
+  X _ := A
+  d _ _ := 0
+  shape _ _ _ := rfl
+  d_comp_d' _ _ _ _ _ := Limits.zero_comp

+set_option synthInstance.maxSize 256 in
+/-- Maps into the internal Hom from a tensor are determined on localized pure tensors.
+Source: Stacks Project, Modules on Sites, Section 03EK and Lemma 03EO.
+(blueprint: lem-sc-hom-tensor-summand-pure-ext).
+
+Proof: Put A and B in every degree of two zero-differential complexes K and L.
+The coproduct universal property gives a codiagonal π from the degree-zero
+term of their tensor total complex to A tensor B; its composite with every
+summand inclusion is the identity. Precompose the argument of a and b with
+π, obtaining maps into internal Hom from this total term. Apply the existing
+localized tensor extensionality theorem: on every pure tensor in every
+summand the codiagonal identity reduces its hypothesis to the hypothesis
+here. Finally precompose the arguments with the (0,0) summand inclusion.
+Functoriality of internal Hom and π after this inclusion being the identity
+recover a=b. The construction works for zero modules and an empty site;
+it does not assert global generation of sections of the sheaf tensor. -/
+theorem homTensorSummandPure_ext (A B N X : Mod) :
+    letI := SheafOfModules.monoidalCategory R
+    ∀ (a b : X ⟶ SheafOfModules.homObj (R := R) (A ⊗ B) N),
+    (∀ (U : Cᵒᵖ) (s : X.val.obj U) (W : (Over U.unop)ᵒᵖ)
+      (x : A.val.obj (op W.unop.left)) (y : B.val.obj (op W.unop.left)),
+      (((a.val.app U).hom s).app W).hom
+        (((homTensorSectionMap R A B).app (op W.unop.left)).hom
+          (x ⊗ₜ[R.obj.obj (op W.unop.left)] y)) =
+      (((b.val.app U).hom s).app W).hom
+        (((homTensorSectionMap R A B).app (op W.unop.left)).hom
+          (x ⊗ₜ[R.obj.obj (op W.unop.left)] y))) → a = b := by
+  let := SheafOfModules.monoidalCategory R
+  intro a b hab
+  let K := constantGradedComplex R A
+  let L := constantGradedComplex R B
+  let π : (CochainComplex.mapBifunctor K L (curriedTensor Mod)).X 0 ⟶ A ⊗ B :=
+    HomologicalComplex.mapBifunctorDesc (K₁ := K) (K₂ := L)
+      (F := curriedTensor Mod) (c := .up ℤ) (fun _ _ _ => 𝟙 (A ⊗ B))
+  have hπ (i j : ℤ) (hij : i + j = 0) :
+      CochainComplex.ιMapBifunctor K L (curriedTensor Mod) i j 0 hij ≫ π =
+        𝟙 (A ⊗ B) := HomologicalComplex.ι_mapBifunctorDesc _ _ _ _
+  have heq : a ≫ SheafOfModules.homObjMap (R := R) π (𝟙 N) =
+      b ≫ SheafOfModules.homObjMap (R := R) π (𝟙 N) := by

+    intro U s W i j hij x y

+          (x ⊗ₜ[R.obj.obj (op W.unop.left)] y))) (hπ i j hij)
+    change (π.val.app (op W.unop.left)).hom
+      (((CochainComplex.ιMapBifunctor K L (curriedTensor Mod)
+        i j 0 hij).val.app (op W.unop.left)).hom
+          (((homTensorSectionMap R A B).app (op W.unop.left)).hom
+            (x ⊗ₜ[R.obj.obj (op W.unop.left)] y))) = _ at hz
+    change (((a.val.app U).hom s).app W).hom
+      ((π.val.app (op W.unop.left)).hom
+        (((CochainComplex.ιMapBifunctor K L (curriedTensor Mod)
+          i j 0 hij).val.app (op W.unop.left)).hom
+            (((homTensorSectionMap R A B).app (op W.unop.left)).hom
+              (x ⊗ₜ[R.obj.obj (op W.unop.left)] y)))) =
+      (((b.val.app U).hom s).app W).hom
+        ((π.val.app (op W.unop.left)).hom
+          (((CochainComplex.ιMapBifunctor K L (curriedTensor Mod)
+            i j 0 hij).val.app (op W.unop.left)).hom
+              (((homTensorSectionMap R A B).app (op W.unop.left)).hom
+                (x ⊗ₜ[R.obj.obj (op W.unop.left)] y))))
+    rw [hz]
+    exact hab U s W x y
+  have hh := congrArg
+    (fun f => f ≫ SheafOfModules.homObjMap (R := R)
+      (CochainComplex.ιMapBifunctor K L (curriedTensor Mod) 0 0 0 (by omega)) (𝟙 N)) heq
+  simpa only [Category.assoc, SheafOfModules.homObjMap_comp_homObjMap,
+    hπ, Category.id_comp, SheafOfModules.homObjMap_id, Category.comp_id] using hh
+
+end CategoryTheory
